candidates.dev-browser: Browser automation with persistent page state, navigate URLs, fill forms
candidates.python-development: Idiomatic Python patterns, type hints, pytest-driven development
candidates.article-writing: Long-form content creation: blog posts, tutorials, newsletters
candidates.brainstorming: Pre-implementation exploration of intent, requirements, architecture
candidates.security-review: Security checklist and architectural review patterns
candidates.archive_manager: ZIP / tar / gz operations — create, extract, inspect
